chapter: Childhood and early music in Algiers
title: Algiers birth, father, and Senator Brady's band
summary: Born in Algiers; father worked in the Southern Pacific roundhouse. Earliest music was Senator Brady's band taught by Professor Humphrey in Wagamon, where Morris lived about 1910-12.
